from pathlib import Path;import json,os
rows=[]
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  exe=os.readlink(p/'exe')
  if Path(exe).name not in ['afs-node','afs-meta','mfsmaster','mfschunkserver','mfsmount']:continue
  stat=(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(') ',1)[1].split();rows.append({'pid':int(p.name),'exe':exe,'start_ticks':stat[19],'cmdline':(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace')})
 except (OSError,IndexError):pass
print(json.dumps({'boot_id':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'processes':rows},indent=2))
